Description

Upon entering the game, the FPS constantly stays at 18–20. This wasn’t the case before — it used to be a stable 120 FPS. I checked the settings and confirmed that the FPS isn’t being limited. The graphics card drivers are up to date. There are no FPS limits in the graphics card driver. There shouldn’t be any issues with the Windows 11 settings. My CPU is an AMD Ryzen 5 5600X, the graphics card is an RTX 5060 with 8 GB of VRAM, and I have 24 GB of RAM.

Also, when I press Alt + F4 in the game, the FPS briefly jumps up to 120, and then the game crashes.

All of this happens in single-player mode, where there are no other players. I’ve already reinstalled the game and cleared the cache, but nothing helps. Thanks in advance!

Reproduction Steps

The problem is serious: the game used to run stably at 120 FPS, but now the FPS drops to 18–20 — and this happens in single‑player mode, where the load should be minimal. The user has already tried the basic troubleshooting steps: they reinstalled the game, cleared the cache, updated the graphics card drivers, and checked the settings — but nothing helped. The Alt + F4 moment is particularly telling: for a split second, the FPS jumps back up to the previous 120.
